result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks, curb ramps with tactile warning pads, and pedestrian signals. The surrounding environment includes sidewalks and street trees, adjacent to what appears to be a school building.

hazards.name: Wide corner radius
hazards.description: The wide curb radius allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians at the crossing.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings are showing signs of wear, which may reduce visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Refresh the crosswalk markings with high-visibility thermoplastic to improve driver awareness.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk and a wide grassy median serving as a pedestrian refuge. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and markings are present, the high-speed design and long crossing distances pose risks to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of image at the zebra crossing

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide, straight lanes encourage higher vehicle speeds, increasing the severity of potential conflicts.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (HAWK)
interventions.description: Install a signal to provide a protected crossing phase for pedestrians across the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the curb at the crossing to shorten the distance pedestrians are exposed to traffic and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to physically slow approaching vehicles.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed arterial roadway completely lacking in pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks or marked crossings. The environment is highly vehicle-centric, characterized by wide lanes, a large grass median, and significant setbacks for commercial land use.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved walkways, forcing any pedestrians to walk in the grass or on the roadway shoulder.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the frame

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible at the intersection, requiring pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of high-speed traffic without protection.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide lanes and open sightlines encourage high vehicle speeds, increasing the risk and potential severity of collisions.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the arterial to provide safe separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with countdown pedestrian signals and curb ramps at the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Utilize the existing median space to create a formal, hardened pedestrian refuge island to break up the crossing distance.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility crosswalk and sidewalks in a residential area, but the wide roadway design suggests high vehicle speeds. Pedestrian safety is compromised by the lack of visible pedestrian signals and potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Wide Intersection
hazards.description: The wide radius and multiple lanes increase pedestrian exposure time and encourage higher vehicle turning speeds.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars on the side street near the crosswalk may block the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines.
